title: PRI due diligence framing
facts: The PRI's LP responsible-investment DDQ structures GP assessment around policy & governance, ESG integration in investment process, portfolio monitoring, and reporting to LPs.
ILPA's ESG assessment framework grades GP maturity from 'not yet started' to 'leading' across the same dimensions — useful for scoring rubrics.

title: SFDR fund classifications
facts: SFDR Article 6 = no sustainability claim; Article 8 = promotes E/S characteristics; Article 9 = sustainable investment objective with do-no-significant-harm and PAI reporting.
Article 9 funds must hold ~100% 'sustainable investments' (per ESMA clarifications), which drove a wave of 2022–23 downgrades to Article 8.

title: ICMA Green Bond Principles
facts: GBP's four pillars: use of proceeds, process for project evaluation & selection, management of proceeds, and reporting (allocation + impact).
A Second Party Opinion (SPO) assesses alignment pre-issuance; leading providers include Sustainalytics, S&P Global (Shades of Green), Moody's and ISS.
Impact reporting typically quantifies tCO2e avoided, renewable capacity added, or equivalent metrics per the Harmonised Framework.

title: ESG-credit risk linkage (banking)
facts: Basel Committee principles (2022) expect banks to embed climate risk in credit assessment: borrower transition plans, collateral physical exposure, and sector heatmaps feeding PD/LGD adjustments.
Common practice: an ESG score notch adjustment to internal ratings, capped so it can't override fundamental credit deterioration.

title: Supplier engagement (CDP Supply Chain pattern)
facts: Effective supplier programmes tier by spend and emissions: top ~20 suppliers usually cover 60–80% of category-1 emissions — start disclosure requests there.
Escalation ladder: information request → improvement plan → contractual clauses → procurement preference/exclusion; CDP Supply Chain membership operationalises the request step.
Ask for supplier-specific (not industry-average) emission factors as maturity grows — it converts spend-based estimates into activity-based data.

title: Case study — engagement beats exclusion
facts: Climate Action 100+ (700+ investors, ~US$68tn AUM at peak) demonstrated coordinated engagement outcomes: majority of focus companies set net-zero ambitions during its first phase.
DD implication: assess a GP/bank's stewardship evidence (voting records, escalation outcomes), not just exclusion lists.

title: Greenwashing enforcement precedents
facts: ASIC's first greenwashing court outcomes (2024) — including against Mercer and Vanguard — established that unsubstantiated ESG screens/claims in fund marketing attract civil penalties.
DD checklists should verify that every public ESG claim maps to a documented, auditable process.
